description: Source of truth for the PingOne user gate on PingFederate's standard two-exchange policy. Applied and checked by scripts/pingfederate/provision-pf-pingone-user-gate.sh. PingOne stays the system of record for who may be acted for: on every exchange PingFederate looks up the PingOne account with the subject's username and refuses unless it is enabled and its mayAct names the AI agent actor. No secret lives in this file.
notGated: The policy's ID-JAG subject mapping is deliberately left alone: the lookup keys on subjecttoken.Username, which was proven for access-token subjects only. Gate it here once an ID-JAG exchange has been tested with the lookup attached.

attributeSource.description: PingOne user with the same username
